SELECT p.id AS productId, p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, p.spec AS spec, p.main_unit_id AS unitId, u.unit_name AS unitName, s.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.available_qty), 0) AS availableQty, COALESCE(SUM(s.lock_qty), 0) AS lockQty, -- 平均成本按 SUM(qty*avg_cost) / SUM(qty) 算 (库存=0 时 AVG 无意义, 返回 0) CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) > 0 THEN SUM(s.qty * s.avg_cost) / SUM(s.qty) ELSE 0 END AS avgCost, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_cost), 0) AS totalCost, MIN(s.batch_no) AS batchNo, MIN(s.last_in_date) AS lastInDate FROM base_product p LEFT JOIN inv_stock s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.deleted = 0
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = p.main_unit_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND ( p.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.spec, p.main_unit_id, u.unit_name, s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) DESC, p.id DESC
